context.content: One of the reasons I didn’t add a Listens section earlier was Jekyll was taking too much to generate all the pages in my website, adding the scrobbles would’ve made it unbearable. So what I started doing was manually filtering through the listens and highliting the best albums, if they’re worth listening to, they deserve a post, right? I think to be able to browse your Listens by artist, see your top tracks by that artist and then all the albums, would be amazing. But if you listen to a lot of music this approach would probably deserve its own website I guess. Oh and the deleted post is actually the same post with a correct URL. I recently switched to Jan-Lukas’ GoBlog and it seems I hadn’t setup the correct URL path for notes.
